methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched and adversarially verified on 2026-06-18: filestage.io/pricing/, ziflow.com/pricing/ (+ /security), approval.studio/pricing/ (+ /security), reviewstudio.com/pricing-plans/, pageproof.com/pricing (+ /security), goproof.net/pricing/ (+ /security), and meetvolley.com/pricing/. Filestage publishes prices in EUR only (no USD shown); recorded as-fetched in EUR within plan notes and monthlyUsd left null where only EUR is published. Ziflow's pricing page displays only the ANNUAL-billed monthly-equivalent ($199/$329) behind a monthly/annual toggle; the true month-to-month rate is higher (~$249/$399) and not published as a clean figure — annualDiscountPct added and noted. Volley's Pro plan headline ($29) is the annual-billed rate discounted 40% from a $49 regular price; framing corrected. ReviewStudio Advanced and Enterprise tiers added (were omitted in draft). PageProof SOC 2 is Azure-platform-inherited (not PageProof's own attestation) → soc2 set to null. Compliance flags set true only where the vendor explicitly states the certification on its own security page; else null. Quote-only/contact-sales tiers carry monthlyUsd=null (a null beats a guess). accessedAt 2026-06-18 throughout.
